decisions.rationale: 'Prader-Willi syndrome' is a single named genetic disorder with one clinical definition, so it is a Specific Disease. The whole phrase is kept as the minimum necessary span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: 'chromosome 15 anomaly' describes a cytogenetic finding in general terms. 'Anomaly' is a general term like 'abnormalities' and the phrase does not name a specific disease or disease class.
Second occurrence of 'Prader-Willi syndrome' in a separate sentence. Duplicate mentions are each annotated, and this is the same Specific Disease as candidate 1.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions); What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease)

decisions.rationale: 'PWS' is the abbreviation of Prader-Willi syndrome given in parentheses right after the long form. It is a synonymous mention of the same Specific Disease and is annotated separately.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (synonymous mentions and abbreviations)

decisions.rationale: '15q11-12 deletion' names a chromosomal deletion, a genetic lesion or karyotype finding, not a disease name. It does not match the Specific Disease or Disease Class definitions, so it is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease definition: a disease name linked to one specific definition)

decisions.rationale: 'PWS' in 'similar to those originally described in PWS' is an abbreviation mention referring to Prader-Willi syndrome, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (synonymous mentions and abbreviations); What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: 'PWS' in 'the hypothesis that PWS is associated with deletion' refers to Prader-Willi syndrome. It is a further occurrence of the same Specific Disease and is annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions); What to Annotate 6 (abbreviations)

decisions.rationale: 'PWS' in 'the clinical definition of PWS' refers to Prader-Willi syndrome as a Specific Disease. It is an abbreviation mention and is annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (abbreviations); What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: 'deletion of 15q11-12' is the same chromosomal deletion as candidate 5. It describes a genetic event or chromosomal anomaly rather than a named disease, so it is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease definition); What NOT to Annotate 5 (non-disease biological processes)

decisions.rationale: 'isochromosome 15' names a chromosomal structural abnormality (a karyotype finding), not a disease or disease class. It is therefore not annotated under the schema.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease definition); What NOT to Annotate 4 (general terms)
